# Shiraz

> Shiraz is an open-source (GPL-3.0-only), GTK-free Android compatibility layer that runs supported Android APKs directly on Linux, Apple Silicon macOS (experimental), and Windows (experimental foundation) using standalone ART, SDL2, and native graphics/audio/OS bridges — without booting an Android system image, virtual machine, container, or kernel binder module.

Snapshot version: v0.367.0 (data updated 2026-11-24).

## Core Facts

- **Execution model:** App-only API translation layer on standalone ART (with pre-warmed WarmArtPool standby daemon on Linux and macOS). No Android VM, LXC container, or binder kernel driver.
- **API 35 Java surface:** 4,445 of 4,445 Android 15 / API 35 `android.*` class names present across 49 packages (class-name presence is not CTS certification or full behavioral parity).
- **API 35 NDK C/C++ surface:** 15 of 15 tracked NDK shared libraries built, exporting 887 of 887 cataloged C symbols (audited with `nm`).
- **Host OS backends:**
  - **Linux (x86_64, ARM64 — primary):** Standalone ART, warm standby pool, GBM/DMA-BUF zero-copy swapchain, ALSA/PipeWire AAudio, bundled `libvulkan.so` with real-ICD `PackageManager` probe, default-on Landlock + `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` sandboxing (`--no-sandbox` opt-out, `--no-network`/`--no-internet` seccomp), WebRTC streaming, AppImage & sandboxed Flatpak (`.flatpak`) builders (CLI `--digitalis` ARM64 bundling).
  - **macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64 — experimental port):** 48 verified, 21 partial, 22 open goal checklist items; ART `mach_vm_remap`/`MAP_JIT`/ARM64 fault primitives, wired `WarmArtPool` standby (`2.67×` faster launch on 2048), ANGLE-Metal zero-copy IOSurface swapchain, SurfaceTexture, `MTLSharedEvent` native fences, 120 Hz `CVDisplayLink` vsync, pinned **MoltenVK v1.4.2** (live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 on Apple M2 Pro across host/guest thunks & Java `PackageManager` `level=1`), VideoToolbox/AudioToolbox, opt-in guest ELF/Bionic loader booting OsmAnd+, F-Droid v2.0.2, Math & Telegram, default-on Seatbelt sandboxing, signed `.app` bundler, and browser `.app` sidecar zip packaging.
  - **Windows (x64, ARM64 — experimental foundation):** 32 verified, 5 partial, 0 open items (CI-verified Win32 primitives, SDL2 presentation/IME/clipboard, DXGI shared AHB, `libvulkan.dll`, WASAPI AAudio/OpenSL ES, Media Foundation decode + `IMFSourceReader` camera capture, DirectWrite, Job Object/Restricted Token sandbox, portable/MSIX bundler; partial foundations for ANGLE-D3D11 Per-Monitor V2 DPI, Win32 ART `NativeBridge` v3 + guest ELF/SysV↔Win64 thunks, and pinned `patches/art-win32-build.patch` + `bootstrap_windows.py` ART orchestrator). Live Win32 `libart.dll` execution remains open.
- **Recorded apps:** 18 apps (17 Partial, 1 Blocked, 0 Historical) across 8 engines (Android framework, Flutter, React Native, Unity, libGDX, Godot, SDL, Arc).
- **Packaging:** Browser-based Go/WASM Builder produces standalone Linux AppImages, sandboxed Flatpak (`.flatpak`) bundles (with Digitalis ARM64 bundling support), and unmodified signed macOS `.app` sidecar zips locally without uploading the APK; CLI also supports `--digitalis` ARM64-on-x86_64 bundling, builds signed macOS `.app` and Windows portable/MSIX bundles, and runs `shiraz install-desktop`.

## Explicit Boundaries (Do Not Misstate)

- Shiraz is experimental. No whole-Android compatibility percentage or CTS certification is claimed.
- Shiraz does **not** include the Google Play Store or Google Play Services.
- OS process sandboxing is enabled by default across `shiraz run`, `shiraz install-desktop`, `shiraz daemon`, Linux AppImages (`--no-sandbox` opt-out, `--no-network`/`--no-internet`), and Flatpak bundles, but this is OS process confinement rather than Android's full per-UID/SELinux sandbox.
- WebView uses an embedded pure-Java HTML5 DOM/JS engine (including interactive `contentEditable`, `Selection`/`Range`, `execCommand`, `MutationObserver`, timers, and DOM storage) rather than a full Blink/V8 browser engine.
- 32-bit ARM (`armeabi-v7a`) native libraries are unsupported; Digitalis ARM64 translation on `x86_64` Linux works in CLI runs and CLI `--digitalis` AppImage/Flatpak builds (not yet in prebuilt browser bases).

## Website Pages

- [Home & Browser Builder](https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/): Architecture overview, Shiraz Web (WebRTC), macOS Launcher, and in-browser AppImage/Flatpak APK packager.
- [Run APK in Browser](https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/run/): 100% client-side in-browser Android APK runner powered by Shiraz (aarch64 Linux runtime) inside [pithings/unkernel](https://github.com/pithings/unkernel) (Linux 7.3 + kwemu on WebAssembly). Zero backend compute.
- [Compatibility & Coverage Tracker](https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/compatibility/): Filterable app compatibility catalog, 3-OS host matrix, 30 subsystem notes, 49-package API 35 breakdown, 15-library NDK audit, and behavioral probe tracker.
- [Compare Shiraz and Its Peers](https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/compare/): Side-by-side comparison with ATL, ACL, a4l, Mac.apk, apklayer, Innkeeper, Waydroid, and Android Emulator.
- [Full AI Context (llms-full.txt)](https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/llms-full.txt): Complete single-file reference with app records, host layers, subsystem limits, and FAQs.

## Detailed Host OS Capability Matrix (2026-11-24)

### Runtime & native ABI
- **Linux (ready):** Standalone ART with warm standby pool & daemon, host ELF + Bionic bridge, Digitalis ARM64-on-x86_64 (CLI + AppImage/Flatpak --digitalis + WASM Digitalis support), 15/15 API 35 NDK libraries (887/887 symbols).
- **macOS (partial):** Standalone ART (-Xint, with verified mach_vm_remap, MAP_JIT + pthread_jit_write_protect_np, and ARM64 fault-handler primitives), WarmArtPool wired in HostSession & ShirazDaemon (402 ms 2048 standby, 2.67× faster), opt-in guest ARM64 ELF/Bionic loader + pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 guest/host Vulkan bridge (OsmAnd+, F-Droid v2.0.2, Math & Telegram libs), 15/15 API 35 NDK libraries, unified 16 KB page-size policy; building libart-compiler.so & M5 signing gate open.
- **Windows (partial):** Unified HostOs / ABI / page-size policy, CreateProcessW process spawning, MinGW-w64 / Clang-UCRT64 build rules (mk/windows.mk), cross-platform tested Win32 ART NativeBridge v3 (libshiraz-win32-guest.dll) + Guest ELF loader with W^X VirtualAlloc & SysV↔Win64 6-arg thunks, and pinned patches/art-win32-build.patch + bootstrap_windows.py ART orchestrator; live Win32 libart.dll execution open.

### Graphics, windowing & input
- **Linux (ready):** SDL2 windows (Wayland & X11, GTK-free), upfront GLES2 window, EGL/GLES, zero-copy GBM/DMA-BUF swapchain, SurfaceTexture, AHB EGLImage & EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync, vsync AChoreographer pacing, bundled libvulkan.so with real-ICD PackageManager probe, Shiraz Web WebRTC streaming.
- **macOS (ready):** SDL2 / Cocoa windows, ANGLE Metal GLES, zero-copy IOSurface swapchain, SurfaceTexture, AHardwareBuffer EGLImage & EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync (MTLSharedEvent), 120 Hz CVDisplayLink vsync pacing, pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 (live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 on Apple M2 Pro across host libvulkan.so, Darwin guest AAPCS64 thunks & Java PackageManager level=1), live resize watch, Retina 2×/fractional pointer mapping, Cmd→Ctrl shortcuts, trackpad pinch & touch filter.
- **Windows (partial):** CI-verified SDL2 / Win32 presentation (WM_SIZE live resize, IMM32/TSF IME, keyboard & clipboard), Per-Monitor V2 DPI & ANGLE-D3D11 window wiring, libvulkan.dll (VK_KHR_android_surface ANativeWindow swapchain & AHB bridge), DXGI adapter probe, EnumDisplaySettingsW refresh rate, shared AHardwareBuffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer pacing & Precision Touchpad hooks; live Windows GPU ANGLE-D3D11 smoke open.

### Audio & video codecs
- **Linux (ready):** ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire audio, OpenSL ES & runtime libasound AAudio, MediaCodec / libmediandk software and host codecs.
- **macOS (partial):** AudioToolbox / CoreAudio AudioQueue hardware AAudio, OpenSL ES, PCM, WAV, AAC & Opus; VideoToolbox H.264, HEVC, VP9 & AV1 decode; video recording unsupported.
- **Windows (partial):** WASAPI PCM16 playback & capture bridge backing libaaudio.dll & libOpenSLES.dll; Media Foundation H.264, HEVC, VP9 & AV1 decoder probe, MFEnumDeviceSources camera enumeration, and IMFSourceReader RGBA frame-capture bridge.

### OS primitives, IPC & isolation
- **Linux (ready):** POSIX memfd/ashmem, epoll ALooper, Unix sockets, default-on Linux Landlock LSM + PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS across CLI/desktop/daemon/AppImage (--no-sandbox opt-out, --no-network/--no-internet seccomp) + Flatpak bubblewrap sandbox.
- **macOS (ready):** POSIX/Mach shared memory, kqueue ALooper, CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW/CLOCK_MONOTONIC clocks, POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT process isolation, FD_CLOEXEC helpers, SDK SQLite, Unix sockets, App Nap guard, default-on macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) SBPL profile (--no-sandbox opt-out) & App Sandbox bundle entitlements.
- **Windows (ready):** CreateFileMappingW shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC with peer PID lookup, SetThreadExecutionState, default-on Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox.

### Desktop services, trust & fonts
- **Linux (ready):** XDG directories, Fontconfig, desktop notifications, file picker, connectivity, Freedesktop .desktop install & URL/file launcher hooks.
- **macOS (ready):** ~/Library paths, CoreText fonts, Security.framework trust anchors (wolfJSSE + OkHttp 32/32), AVFoundation speech voices, UNUserNotificationCenter, CoreLocation, /usr/bin/open & osascript picker.
- **Windows (ready):** LOCALAPPDATA / APPDATA paths, DirectWrite fonts, native UTF-16/UTF-8 Win32 clipboard, DPAPI keystore, SAPI5 speech probe, GetAdaptersAddresses connectivity, Shell_NotifyIconW, Windows Location COM, WinForms picker & rundll32 URL launcher.

### Packaging & CI
- **Linux (ready):** Browser & CLI per-app AppImage and sandboxed Flatpak (.flatpak) builders (with bundled libvulkan.so, default-on Landlock sandbox, and Digitalis ARM64-on-x86_64 bundling support), .deb packages, shiraz install-desktop, Linux x86_64 & ARM64 CI releases.
- **macOS (ready):** Signed Shiraz.app bundle builder (hardened runtime, allow-jit, optional --sandbox entitlements, @rpath closure, .icns), browser .app sidecar zip packager (go-wasm/macos_app.go, leaving signed Shiraz.app untouched), SwiftUI Launcher (default-on Seatbelt + MoltenVK ICD), per-APK install-desktop (~/Applications), macOS ARM64 CI.
- **Windows (ready):** Portable Shiraz\ & MSIX AppxManifest.xml bundler (PE32/PE32+ import resolver, .ico generator), Start Menu install-desktop, Windows x64 MinGW-w64 CI (make windows-check, libshiraz-win32-guest.dll, windows-presentation-check & test-win32-guest-elf.exe).

## Recorded Applications (18 total)

- **OsmAnd** (Android framework + JNI) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-23–24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough of OsmAnd+ rendered native vector maps (with Persian RTL labels), ran offline search (185 results), completed turn-by-turn pedestrian routing & navigation (maneuver countdown, live GPS updates, TTS prompts, arrival), downloaded offline maps over HTTPS (World_basemap.obf 468 MB & altitude data), resized portrait ↔ landscape, and persisted zoom across restart (9.42 s WarmArtPool standby reuse / 9.84 s warm first present). Earlier Linux runs also reached maps, drawer, and route details.
  - Limitations: Building libart-compiler.so for ART JIT (beyond MAP_JIT code cache/remap/fault primitives), M5 hardened-runtime signing gates, and Linux/Waydroid visual parity comparison remain open.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **F-Droid** v2.0.2 (Android framework + JNI) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough of F-Droid v2.0.2 (Jetpack Compose + WorkManager + Room SQLite) rendered Material 3 Discover, Search, My apps, and Repositories screens, switched to two-pane tablet landscape (left navigation rail + detail pane) and back to portrait, and triggered RepoUpdateWorker on Fetch repositories.
  - Limitations: Full index-v2 repository ingestion did not finish within 50 s under -Xint, clean exit waits on background coroutine threads, and APK installation via F-Droid remains unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **Math** v1.0.2 (Android framework + JNI) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough loaded its 2 arm64-v8a native libraries, evaluated 7×6 = 42 via live pointer taps, switched to the Material 3 Unit Converter tab, relaid out across 3-column portrait ↔ 5-column landscape ↔ portrait, and exited cleanly.
  - Limitations: Full scientific/graphing coverage and restart persistence remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **Editor** v1.98 (Android framework) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough dismissed the Files permission dialog, accepted live UTF-8 keyboard text entry, relaid out across portrait ↔ landscape ↔ portrait, and exited cleanly.
  - Limitations: File save/open round-trips and full menu actions remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **Crossword** v1.26 (Android framework) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough entered pattern 123s567, ran live dictionary word lookup returning matching words (abasers, abashed, abashes, abasing, abusage, abusers, abusing), relaid out across portrait ↔ landscape ↔ portrait, and exited cleanly.
  - Limitations: Anagram/clue solver modes and navigation drawer actions remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **SolitaireCG** v4.1 (Android framework) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Live 2026-11-24 macOS ARM64 Metal/ANGLE walkthrough dealt cards from the stock pile (15 → 9), updated the live game clock, relaid out across portrait ↔ landscape ↔ portrait, exited cleanly, and restored the exact dealt cards, stock counter, and running timer across restart.
  - Limitations: Drag-and-drop card plays, full game completion, and alternate game modes remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **Obtainium** (Flutter) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Settings, text input, theme persistence, GitHub release lookup, saved entries, resizing, and manual JSON export/import were exercised.
  - Limitations: Release downloads encounter a storage-path assumption. Installation and clean-state restoration remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/flutter/OBTAINIUM.md
- **Joplin** (React Native) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Notes list, Add menu, note screen, title entry, and title persistence across restart were verified.
  - Limitations: Body editing is unsupported in Joplin's CodeMirror 6 APK until retested: Shiraz's pure-Java WebView now adds interactive contentEditable, Selection/Range, execCommand, MutationObserver, timers, and DOM storage, but is not a full Blink/V8 browser engine.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/react-native/JOPLIN.md
- **SEN-214 Calculator** (React Native) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Basic arithmetic, sin(30), numeric dialog input, and 5P2 were verified.
  - Limitations: Short-window controls overlap; result text may disappear after resize. Full scientific functionality and persistence remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/react-native/SEN_214_CALCULATOR.md
- **Lucas Doggiehood** (Unity) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Animated scene, settings, camera drag, zoom, quests, item collection, and reward persistence were verified in successful runs.
  - Limitations: Portrait clipping, intermittent startup stalls, lifecycle timeouts, audio, and longer progression remain open.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/unity/LUCAS_DOGGIEHOOD.md
- **Unciv** (libGDX) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Map interaction, exploration, city founding, save/reload, portrait relayout, research, and Worker production were verified.
  - Limitations: Rendering stability and longer campaigns remain under test. PCM capture does not establish speaker output or audio timing.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/libgdx/UNCIV.md
- **Abra-Ca Bubble** (Godot) — **Blocked**
  - Observed: The ARM64 build reaches an interactive Vulkan requirements warning.
  - Limitations: Host libvulkan.so/.dll, Darwin guest libvulkan.so, pinned in-tree MoltenVK v1.4.2 (live Vulkan 1.4.357 on Apple M2 Pro with PackageManager level=1), and real-ICD Vulkan feature probing are wired, but live Vulkan game rendering inside Abra-Ca Bubble remains unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/godot/ABRA_CA_BUBBLE.md
- **SuperTux** (SDL) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Menus, world map, movement, jumping, coin collection, death/restart, resizing, and selected-node restoration were exercised.
  - Limitations: Level completion, campaign persistence, and speaker output remain unverified. Portrait controls overlap.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/sdl/SUPERTUX.md
- **Tiny Crate** (Godot) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Menu, keyboard movement, jumping, first two levels, crate handling, and two-star progress after restart were verified.
  - Limitations: Full touch gameplay, physical audio, clean shutdown, and later levels remain unverified. Portrait rendering uses letterboxing.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/godot/TINY_CRATE.md
- **Mindustry** (Arc) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Campaign world, touch dragging, mining, drill/conveyor construction, core delivery, and saved progress were verified.
  - Limitations: Portrait tutorial text clips. Tutorial completion, combat, and audio remain under test.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/arc/MINDUSTRY.md
- **Ember Quest** (Flutter) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Scene, menu, keyboard movement, jumping, Game Over, and Play Again were verified.
  - Limitations: Portrait-to-landscape resize clips the player. Collection, progression, persistence, and audio remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/experiments/flutter/EMBER_QUEST.md
- **2048 (tpcstld)** v1.3.3 (Android framework) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Upstream 1.3.3 renders the board; pointer swipes move tiles, two 2 tiles merge into 4 and score increases. Landscape relayout works; board, score and high score survive a clean restart. On macOS Apple Silicon, wired WarmArtPool standby reuse launches in 402 ms vs 1,072 ms direct (2.67× faster).
  - Limitations: A dismissible Google Play Services warning appears on startup and activity recreation. Long games, reaching 2048, Play services features and the current Google Play build remain unverified.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md
- **Telegram** v13.2.1 (Android framework + JNI) — **Partial**
  - Observed: Telegram 13.2.1 on macOS ARM64 loads its native library and supports onboarding, country selection, text input and portrait/landscape resizing. Authentication reached a successful server response.
  - Limitations: Signed-in chat UI, saved login across restart, messaging, calls and physical microphone/camera capture remain unverified. Video recording and remote/cast routing are unsupported. Component media tests do not establish Telegram media support.
  - Evidence: https://github.com/spectre-oss/shiraz/blob/main/docs/tested.md

## Maintained Android Subsystems (30 areas, reviewed 2026-11-24)

- **Java / DEX runtime** [Shared framework · Partial · Component and app flows]: Standalone ART (with pre-warmed WarmArtPool standby wired into HostSession and ShirazDaemon on both Linux and macOS, ART MAP_JIT/mach_vm_remap/ARM64 fault-handler primitives on Darwin, and AOT/page-cache pre-warming on Linux), active-session AlarmManager wakeup delivery (unblocking AndroidX WorkManager), multi-DEX loading, and all 4,445 Android API 35 android.* class surfaces compile and smoke-test on OpenJDK and ART. Complete method-level Android behavior and Darwin libart-compiler.so JIT remain incremental.
- **Views, input and lifecycle** [Shared framework · Partial · App and component tests]: Layouts, widgets, transitions, property animations, accessibility nodes, IME sessions, pointer input and resizing are exercised; complex custom app flows still expose gaps.
- **Resources and themes** [Shared framework · Partial · App flows]: APK resources, binary XML attributes, ICU formatting, density/configuration changes and selected theme paths work; full Material theme parity remains incomplete.
- **Files and preferences** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: Committed preferences, queued apply writes, PreferenceScreen hierarchies, unified Linux/macOS/Windows OS data paths and DocumentsContract/MediaStore URI models pass OpenJDK/ART tests. Telegram saved-login persistence is still unverified.
- **SQLite storage** [Shared framework · Partial · App and component tests]: Host SQLite, CursorWindow, MergeCursor, CursorJoiner, SQLiteQueryBuilder and SQLiteRawStatement are exercised; every Android SQLite edge case is not established.
- **Networking and TLS** [Shared framework · Partial · Targeted probes]: Guest sockets, TLS, DnsResolver, HttpEngine over HttpURLConnection and LinkProperties/IKEv2 models exist; a historical targeted network run records 49 passes while the full suite remains unrun.
- **Binder and Android services** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: Selected in-process/host IPC services, AccountManager, Telecom CallControl and service SPI classes exist. Full Android system_server behavior and cross-process compatibility are not established.
- **Canvas, EGL and GLES** [Shared framework · Partial · App and component tests]: Real apps render through software/host EGL/GLES paths alongside ColorSpace connectors, ImageDecoder, YuvImage and OpenGL Matrix/ETC1 helpers. Full hardware-accelerated RenderNode parity is not verified.
- **PDF, print and gestures** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: Pure-Java %PDF-1.4 writer, software PDF rasterizer, text search/selection/annotations, PrintDocumentAdapter pipelines and 2D gesture stroke recognition pass on OpenJDK and ART; host print spooling is not wired.
- **Media containers, EXIF and RenderScript** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: WAV/ISO-BMFF MediaExtractor and MediaMuxer, TIFF/JPEG ExifInterface read-write, DTMF ToneGenerator, Visualizer DFT and CPU RenderScript intrinsics pass component tests; broad codec coverage remains bounded.
- **AppSearch, Health Connect and AdServices** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: In-memory AppSearch BM25 indexing, Health Connect typed records/unit conversions and AdServices models pass on OpenJDK and ART; cross-app Android system stores are not emulated.
- **Keystore, Identity, Credentials and NDEF** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: Host keystore entries, ISO 18013-5 Identity Credential COSE/CBOR sessions, CredentialManager models and NFC Forum NDEF/BLE scan wire codecs work in-process; Secure Element, NFC RF and Bluetooth radios fail explicitly.
- **NDK native C/C++ libraries** [Linux and macOS ARM64 · Partial · Native unit tests and nm audit]: All 15 tracked Android API 35 NDK shared libraries (887/887 cataloged C symbols across libandroid, libjnigraphics, libmediandk, libsync, libOpenSLES, libaaudio, liblog, libicu, libamidi, libcamera2ndk, libOpenMAXAL, libbinder_ndk, libneuralnetworks, libvulkan and libnativewindow) build and pass native behavioral tests, including VK_KHR_android_surface ANativeWindow swapchain, AHardwareBuffer memory bridges, pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 on Apple M2 Pro (host libvulkan.so, Darwin guest AAPCS64 thunks, and Java PackageManager level=1), and AppImage/Flatpak bundling; live Vulkan game rendering remains unverified and physical Camera2 hardware capture remains host-dependent.
- **Android native ELF / Bionic** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · App and component tests]: Opt-in guest loader (SHIRAZ_GUEST_LOADER=1) boots OsmAnd+ (7 native libs, 4,090 TPIDR rewrites, live Tehran vector maps, turn-by-turn pedestrian routing & 468 MB HTTPS downloads), F-Droid v2.0.2, Math (2 ARM64 libs), and Telegram (18 constructors, JNI_OnLoad), adds pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 + Darwin guest libvulkan.so AAPCS64 thunks, powl/sqrtl, property read callbacks, dynamic library admission, and unified 16 KB page-size policy. M5 strict hardened-runtime signing gate and full syscall coverage remain open.
- **Audio playback, AAC and Opus** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · Component tests]: AudioToolbox AudioQueue hardware AAudio and PCM output, WAV/AAC/Opus decode (AudioToolbox), AAC encode and timestamps tested with synthetic media and live CoreAudio output. Telegram voice messages and calls remain unverified.
- **VideoToolbox hardware decode** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · Native unit tests]: libshiraz-video.so decodes H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1 through VideoToolbox alongside AudioToolbox Opus; end-to-end app playback and DRM remain unverified.
- **macOS notifications, location, Metal and gestures** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · Native and app tests]: UNUserNotificationCenter notifications, CoreLocation wired into Android LocationManager, 120 Hz CVDisplayLink hardware vsync pacing, zero-copy IOSurface swapchain, SurfaceTexture, AHardwareBuffer EGLImage & EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync (MTLSharedEvent), Security.framework TLS trust (32/32 wolfJSSE/OkHttp + OsmAnd+ HTTPS fetch), AVFoundation speech voices, App Nap guard, Cocoa live-resize events, Retina 2x/fractional pointer mapping, Cmd-to-Ctrl shortcuts and trackpad pinch/touch filtering are verified on Apple Silicon; interactive TCC prompts in end-user apps remain under test.
- **Signed macOS .app bundle builder** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · macOS build and bundle tests]: Builds self-contained signed Shiraz.app bundles with hardened runtime, allow-jit and optional --sandbox App Sandbox entitlements, @rpath library closure and generated .icns icons, plus browser Go/WASM .app sidecar zip packaging (keeping signed Shiraz.app byte-for-byte untouched beside AppData/) and SwiftUI Launcher default-on Seatbelt + MoltenVK ICD wiring; notarized release distribution is not yet published.
- **Microphone and camera** [macOS ARM64 · Partial · Hardware unverified]: Host bridges and foreground consent checks exist; physical capture in Telegram has not been verified. JPEG tests use synthetic pixels.
- **Video recording** [macOS ARM64 · Unsupported · Explicit limitation]: The macOS video-recording pipeline is not implemented. Audio-only recording APIs do not imply video support.
- **Android sensors** [macOS ARM64 · Unsupported · Explicit limitation]: No Android sensor event bridge is advertised on Darwin.
- **Remote media / casting** [macOS ARM64 · Unsupported · Explicit limitation]: Only a local default audio route is provided. Remote and cast routing are unavailable.
- **Windows Win32 host primitives and IPC** [Windows x64 / ARM64 · Partial · Windows CI native unit tests]: 32/37 goal checklist items CI-verified and 5 partial (0 open): CreateFileMappingW shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC with peer PID lookup, DXGI GPU probe, EnumDisplaySettingsW refresh rate, Per-Monitor V2 DPI & ANGLE-D3D11 window wiring, DXGI shared AHardwareBuffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer pacing, libvulkan.dll ANativeWindow swapchain/AHB bridge, SDL2 Win32 presentation/IME/clipboard/keyboard (test-presentation.exe), CreateProcessW spawning, SetThreadExecutionState, Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox, Win32 ART NativeBridge v3 C ABI adapter (libshiraz-win32-guest.dll) + guest ELF loader with W^X VirtualAlloc & SysV↔Win64 thunks, pinned patches/art-win32-build.patch + bootstrap_windows.py ART orchestrator, and HostOs/rundll32 launchers. Live Win32 libart.dll execution remains open.
- **Windows WASAPI, Media Foundation, DirectWrite and services** [Windows x64 / ARM64 · Partial · Windows CI native unit tests]: WASAPI PCM16 playback & capture bridge backing libaaudio.dll and libOpenSLES.dll, Media Foundation H.264/HEVC decoder probing, MFEnumDeviceSources camera enumeration and IMFSourceReader RGBA8888 frame capture (shiraz_win32_camera_capture_frame), DirectWrite system font enumeration, GetAdaptersAddresses connectivity, DPAPI keystore, SAPI5 speech probe, Shell_NotifyIconW notifications and Windows Location COM bridges build and pass MinGW-w64 CI tests (make windows-check); interactive end-to-end app media playback on Windows is not yet verified.
- **Windows portable and MSIX bundler** [Windows x64 / ARM64 · Partial · Python and Windows CI tests]: Portable Shiraz\ directory and MSIX AppxManifest.xml bundler with PE32/PE32+ import closure, .ico generation, and Start Menu install-desktop integration, validated in 3-OS CI; signed Windows installer releases are not yet published.
- **App isolation and sandboxing** [All hosts · Partial · Native, CLI and Python policy tests]: Default-on cross-platform SandboxPolicy enforced across shiraz run, shiraz install-desktop, shiraz daemon, and Linux AppImages (--no-sandbox opt-out, --no-network/--no-internet): maps to Linux Landlock LSM + PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS + seccomp-BPF network deny (plus Flatpak bubblewrap bundles), macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) SBPL profiles + App Sandbox entitlements, and Windows Job Objects + Restricted Tokens; OS process confinement is not Android's full per-UID/SELinux sandbox.
- **WebView JavaScript / DOM** [Shared framework · Partial · Component tests]: Embedded pure-Java HTML5 DOM parser, CSS selector engine, interactive contentEditable/<textarea>/<input> editing bridged to EditText, Selection/Range & document.execCommand, MutationObserver, Handler-backed setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame/queueMicrotask, localStorage/sessionStorage, step-budgeted JavaScript evaluator, @JavascriptInterface reflection bridge, postWebMessage, findAllAsync and multi-entry back/forward history pass OpenJDK/ART tests; a full Blink/V8 CSS layout browser engine for complex SPAs is not bundled.
- **Google Play services runtime** [Shared framework · Unsupported · Explicit limitation]: Shiraz does not provide the Google Play Store or Google Play system services. Bundled client libraries do not supply those services.
- **Cellular telephony and SMS** [Shared framework · Unverified · Not accepted]: E.164 formatting, GSM 7-bit/UCS-2 SMS PDU codecs and CellInfo models work in Java, but Shiraz makes no claim of real modem control, phone calls or carrier SMS.
- **Android platform certification** [All hosts · Unverified · Not measured]: No complete CTS/VTS run, complete API behavior result or whole-platform compatibility percentage is established.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers)

### How does Shiraz run Android apps without a virtual machine or Waydroid?
Shiraz executes Android DEX bytecode on a standalone host build of ART (Android Runtime) and translates Android framework, resource, and NDK calls directly into host OS APIs using SDL2, EGL/GLES (GBM/DMA-BUF zero-copy on Linux, ANGLE-Metal IOSurface on macOS), and native audio/IPC bridges. Unlike Waydroid or Android Emulator, Shiraz does not boot an Android OS image, does not require a virtual machine, and does not require the Linux binder kernel module or root access.

### How do I convert an Android APK into a Linux AppImage or Flatpak?
Open Shiraz Builder at https://spectre-oss.github.io/shiraz/#builder, choose your CPU architecture (x86_64 or ARM64) and output format (AppImage or sandboxed Flatpak `.flatpak`), select your local APK file, and click Build. Assembly runs locally in your browser via Go WebAssembly against a SHA-256-verified runtime base — the APK never leaves your device. From source, run `make appimage APK=/path/to/app.apk` or `make flatpak APK=/path/to/app.apk`.

### How does Shiraz compare to ATL, Mac.apk, and Waydroid?
- **vs. Waydroid / Android Emulator:** Waydroid boots a full LineageOS container requiring kernel binder; Shiraz runs only the app with no OS boot or binder module, trading full-Android breadth for desktop-native footprint.
- **vs. Android Translation Layer (ATL):** Both are GPL-3.0 standalone-ART translation layers (Shiraz reuses ATL's bionic translation linker under its original notice). Shiraz is GTK-free (SDL2 across Linux, macOS, and Windows), adds browser AppImage/Flatpak packaging, WebRTC streaming, and warm ART pre-warming.
- **vs. Mac.apk:** Mac.apk targets Apple Silicon Macs exclusively using dex2jvm on OpenJDK (AGPL-3.0 + commercial) and currently reports more verified consumer games (52/66). Shiraz runs DEX directly on standalone ART under GPL-3.0-only across Linux, Apple Silicon macOS, and Windows.

### Does Shiraz include Google Play Services or full sandboxing?
No. Shiraz does not ship the Google Play Store or Google Play Services. For isolation, OS-level sandboxing is enabled by default across `shiraz run`, `shiraz install-desktop`, `shiraz daemon`, and Linux AppImages (`--no-sandbox` opt-out; `--no-network` / `--no-internet` to deny sockets) via Linux Landlock LSM + `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` + seccomp-BPF, macOS Seatbelt + App Sandbox entitlements, and Windows Job Objects + Restricted Tokens, alongside Flatpak bubblewrap bundles. Because host process confinement is not Android's full per-UID/SELinux sandbox, still only run APKs you trust.
